job: Determine whether instantaneous driver inhibition can be credited as instantaneous K3 contact muting.
limitations: Coil inductances are Omron reference values, not guaranteed endpoints; fixed L omits moving armature and hysteresis.

Five percent of initial current is a diagnostic metric, not the manufacturer's release-voltage test or a contact-state model.

Generic27C diode and Level1 MOS/capacitance models are engineering surrogates; actual clamps, cable and hot semiconductor behavior are unqualified.
